extDescription.message: Turn sideways images and videos upright from the right-click menu: rotate or flip them in place, or open them rotated in a new tab.

viewerSaveBlocked.message: Can’t save a copy: this site doesn’t let other pages read the image’s pixels. Use Save image as… on the page instead.

viewerNoSource.message: Nothing to show: right-click an image or video and choose Rotate › Open in new tab.

viewerLoadFailed.message: This can’t be shown outside its page. Some sites only stream media to their own pages.

optionsStyleSingleSub.message: “Rotate image”: each click turns it a quarter turn

optionsStyleFullSub.message: “Rotate ▸” with every turn and flip, Reset and Open in new tab

optionsSingleHintNoKeys.message: With one item, keep clicking to keep turning: four clicks is upright again. For flips, zoom and Reset, choose Full menu, or set shortcuts on Chrome’s Keyboard shortcuts page.

optionsSingleHint.message: With one item, keep clicking to keep turning: four clicks is upright again. For flips and zoom, point at it and press $VIEWER$ to open it in a new tab; $RESET$ resets it. Or choose Full menu to have everything on the right-click menu.

optionsKeyZoom.message: Zoom out / in, fit, actual size

commandRotateRight.message: Rotate the image under the pointer clockwise

commandRotateLeft.message: Rotate the image under the pointer counterclockwise

commandReset.message: Reset the image under the pointer

optionsShortcutsHint.message: Set a shortcut, then point at an image or video and press it.

optionsNoShortcuts.message: None set yet. Add them on Chrome’s Keyboard shortcuts page.

optionsSingleKeySub.message: Point at an image or video and press R (clockwise), L (counterclockwise) or 0 (reset), with no other key

optionsSingleKeyWarning.message: Chrome will warn that this can “read and change your data” on those sites: it’s what lets the key be heard there. Nothing is read or sent.

optionsChosenHint.message: Each site asks for access when you add it.

optionsExtraKeysSub.message: H and V flip horizontally and vertically

optionsNeverHint.message: Sites whose own keys you’d rather keep. YouTube uses L (forward 10 seconds) and 0 (back to the start) while you point at its player.

optionsDenied.message: Chrome didn’t grant access, so nothing changed.

commandOpenViewer.message: Open the image under the pointer in a new tab, to flip and zoom
